∀ {Digest : Type} (verifier : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.LifecycleVerifier Digest)
  (scheme : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinPolicySnapshot.PolicyDigestScheme)
  (state : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinJointFence.JointState Digest scheme)
  (proposal : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinJointFence.JointAcknowledgementProposal verifier scheme),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinJointFence.CanCommitJointAcknowledgement verifier scheme state proposal →
    proposal.expectedFence.sequence = state.fenceSequence ∧
      proposal.expectedFence.admissionRevision = state.publication.bundle.admission.revision ∧
        proposal.expectedFence.policyRevision = state.policy.revision ∧
          proposal.expectedFence.policyDigest = state.policy.digest ∧
            ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinPolicySnapshot.CanCommitAcknowledgement verifier scheme
              state.policy state.publication proposal.acknowledgement

  (scheme : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinPolicySnapshot.PolicyDigestScheme)
  (state : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinJointFence.JointState Digest scheme)
  (proposal : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinJointFence.JointAcknowledgementProposal verifier scheme)
  (committable :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinJointFence.CanCommitJointAcknowledgement verifier scheme state
      proposal),
  (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinJointFence.commitJointAcknowledgement verifier scheme state proposal
            committable).committedFence.sequence =
      state.fenceSequence + 1 ∧
    (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinJointFence.commitJointAcknowledgement verifier scheme state proposal
                committable).acknowledgement.closedBundle.obligation.phase =
      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinPublicationOutbox.PublicationPhase.acknowledged
